Dark-mode variant of the base palette

Source: R/theme.R
dark_mt_colors.Rd

Lightened tints of mt_colors/mt_colors3/mt_colors4/mt_colors5/mt_colors12, each hue's HSL lightness raised to keep adequate contrast against a near-black background. Used by theme_mt(dark = TRUE) as the discrete palette and geom fill defaults; exported separately so the same tints can be reused directly (e.g. in a hand-written scale_color_manual()) without re-deriving them. dark_mt_colors12[i] is the dark counterpart of mt_colors12[i] at every position.

Usage

dark_mt_colors

dark_mt_colors3

dark_mt_colors4

dark_mt_colors5

dark_mt_colors12

Examples

dark_mt_colors
#> [1] "#70ceeb" "#eb70af"
dark_mt_colors5
#> [1] "#70ceeb" "#eb70af" "#ebad70" "#c270eb" "#7b91e0"
dark_mt_colors12
#>  [1] "#70ceeb" "#eb70af" "#ebad70" "#c270eb" "#7b91e0" "#e755e2" "#e76855"
#>  [8] "#9f8bef" "#8befe6" "#ef8ba4" "#efd68b" "#55a3e7"
